market_news.snippet: In an effort to address the persistent conflict, U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are headed abroad for critical peace negotiations. President Trump has indicated the existence of a new proposal designed to bring an end to hostilities. Their itinerary includes a stop in Moscow, with possible discussions extending to Ukraine.
